cards.name: Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card

benefits.name: Delta Resy credit
benefits.quote: you can earn up to $20 per month in statement credits on eligible purchases at over 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants
benefits.notes: Enroll your card first. Pay with this card at a U.S. Resy restaurant.

benefits.name: Airport rideshare credit
benefits.quote: Earn up to $10 in statement credits each month after using your Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card on U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers.
benefits.notes: Enrollment is required. Applies to U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers.

benefits.name: Delta Stays credit
benefits.quote: an annual statement credit of up to $200 after using your Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card to book prepaid hotels or vacation rentals through Delta Stays on delta.com
benefits.notes: Only prepaid hotels or vacation rentals booked through Delta Stays on delta.com and paid for with this card count.

benefits.name: Venue concessions credit
benefits.quote: Plus enroll your Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases up to $250 per calendar year.
benefits.notes: Enroll your card. One enrolled card per Card Member. Applies at select stadiums and arenas.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.quote: Receive either a statement credit every 4 years after you apply for Global Entry ($120) or a statement credit after you apply for a five-year membership for TSA PreCheck® (up to $85 through a TSA PreCheck official enrollment provider)
benefits.notes: Pay the application fee with this card. The credit is $120 for Global Entry every 4 years, or up to $85 for a five-year TSA PreCheck membership.

benefits.name: Companion Certificate
benefits.quote: Enjoy a Companion Certificate on a Delta First, Delta Comfort, or Delta Main round-trip flight within the U.S. and to Mexico, the Caribbean, or Central America each year after renewal of your Card.
benefits.notes: You get one certificate each year, after you renew. Delta Basic fares are not eligible, and you still pay government taxes and fees of $22 to $250.

benefits.name: MQD Headstart
benefits.quote: With MQD Headstart, you can receive $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars each Medallion Qualification Year
benefits.notes: $2,500 toward Delta Medallion status each Medallion Qualification Year.

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club visits

benefits.notes: Only when you are flying Delta: 15 visits each Medallion Year. Spend $75,000 on the card in a calendar year to unlock unlimited access.

benefits.name: Centurion Lounge
benefits.quote: Enjoy complimentary access to The Centurion® Lounge when you book your Delta flight with your Reserve Card.
benefits.notes: For Delta flights: access applies when you book your Delta flight with this card.

benefits.name: Delta free checked bags
benefits.quote: Enjoy your first checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide
benefits.notes: First checked bag free on Delta flights worldwide. On domestic Delta flights the second bag is free too.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle status
benefits.quote: Transform your car rental experience with Hertz President’s Circle® Status, compliments of your Delta SkyMiles® Reserve American Express Card.
benefits.notes: Add your Hertz Gold+ account number to your SkyMiles account and enroll in the promotion at delta.com/hertz.
